newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Sexy bikinis banned from Honduran beaches.
newsitem.headline: Sexy bikinis banned from Honduran beaches.

text.p: A Honduran provincial governor on Tuesday barred women from wearing sexy G-string bikinis on beaches over Easter so as not to "fire up the passions of men."
Cortes province Gov. Eloy Page said sun worshippers found wearing skimpy swimwear on Atlantic coast beaches would be punished but he did not specify what the sanctions would be.

"Women have no reason to wear these dental floss bikinis because they fire up the passions of men ... above all when they have a few drinks inside them," Page told reporters. He said alcohol-fired suitors could have their sexual desires awakened and assault female bathers.
Beaches in Cortes, which has already banned wet T-shirt competitions for women in bars, are the traditional Easter holiday haunt for Hondurans looking for sun, sea and sand.
